verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a fully documented, standards-based JMAP API (with OAuth/Bearer auth, API tokens, autodiscovery via `.well-known/jmap`) that technically supports reading, querying, and sending mail in a single HTTP round trip — confirmed live and functioning via runtime probes. However, none of the evidence shows a purpose-built AI-agent connector, Claude/ChatGPT plugin, or MCP-style integration — an agent developer would have to build the JMAP/OAuth client themselves rather than use an off-the-shelf documented AI connection. Missing for 10: an official AI-agent/MCP connector or explicit Claude/ChatGPT integration docs, and any hands-on evidence of an agent actually completing the full read-triage-draft-send loop end to end.
